# DXC - prebuilt DirectX Shader Compiler

Headers and runtime libraries of Microsoft's DirectX Shader Compiler
(https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler), release v1.9.2602: the Linux library reports
`LLVM 3.7-v1.9.2602-7-gd355aa836`.

## Licence

`LICENSE.TXT` (the LLVM Release License, University of Illinois/NCSA) and
`ThirdPartyNotices.txt` (the components DXC includes) are the files of the v1.9.2602 tag. Both go
into the third-party notices (Code/Tools/third-party-notices.py); a game's player never carries
DXC itself.
